title: Goodfellas
synopsis: As far back as you can remember, you wanted to be a gangster. You got it. Now the day starts at 6 a.m. and ends at 6 a.m. and the helicopter is, again, overhead.

nodes.text: Paulie's cabstand. Errands. The first time you watch a car burn.

choices.consequence: “Be useful” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: In.
You commit to “Walk home.” The story records the instinct as “Out” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: The men dress like the men. You imitate, you belong.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Path.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.

nodes.text: Tommy is funny. Tommy is dangerous.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Survive.
You commit to “Don't laugh.” The story records the instinct as “Brave” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Jimmy hands out hundred-dollar bills like a god.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Take it” back. In shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Out.

nodes.text: You meet her at a wedding. She is, briefly, terrified.

choices.consequence: “Be charming” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Heart.
There is no taking “Be honest” back. Truth shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: You marry. Her mother does not know what to make of you.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Strategy.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Direct.

nodes.text: Trucks at JFK. The first big score.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Smart.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Greedy.

nodes.text: Tommy shoots Spider in the foot. Then in the chest.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Be silent” back. Survive shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: Six million in cash and gold. Jimmy gets paranoid.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Wise.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Greedy.

nodes.text: Florida. Pittsburgh. You start using.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Stop” back. Wise shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Don't stop” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: She finds your stash. She flushes it. She is furious.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honor—follows you into whatever comes next.
You commit to “Yell back.” The story records the instinct as “Stress” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Tommy is told he'll be made. He goes to a basement.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Wise.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Naive—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: It was for Billy Batts. The whole street goes quiet.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.
“Don't drink” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Discipline.

nodes.text: The helicopter. The sauce. The phone calls. Cocaine.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Try.
“Push through” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: Karen sells what she can. You're out.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Survive.

nodes.text: Jimmy offers you a trip to Florida. You realize, late, it's a hit.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Survive.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Survive.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.

nodes.text: You point at Jimmy. You point at Paulie. The room is, briefly, silent.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honor.
There is no taking “Tell it carefully” back. Smart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: A house. A driveway. A grocery store. Spaghetti with ketchup.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Try to like it” back. Honor shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Hate it openly” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: You order eggs in a bathrobe. You wave at the camera. You realize you're an average nobody.

choices.consequence: “Hate it” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Survive—follows you into whatever comes next.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You spend the rest of your life as Henry Hill, by another name. You write a book in your fifties. You die in 2012 of a heart attack.
You break protection. You return to New York anyway. You die in a parking lot in a year. Karen survives. The children are okay.
You make amends with Karen, with the kids, with yourself. The amends do not pay back what you took. They pay forward, modestly, to children who were not yours.
